whatIsIt.eli5: Blurs the notes a tiny bit by averaging neighbours.
whatIsIt.simple: Averages each 2×2 window with stride 1 (YOLOv9 ADown/AConv), which smooths the map before downsampling.
whatIsIt.engineer: F.avg_pool2d(x, 2, 1, 0, False, True): H → H−1; not counted by thop (functional).

whyExists.eli5: Smoothing first makes the next shrink step lose less.
whyExists.simple: A light blur before striding reduces aliasing.
